retainedReference.title: Library of Ahmed III, Topkapi Palace

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Whole corner view: pale marble cross-shaped body, exposed basement vents, two window rows, tall pointed upper windows, front open portico and side stair approach; low lead domes and shallow vaulted arm roofs.

pictures.author: Giovanni Dall'Orto
pictures.observed: Main shallow lead dome seated on pale octagonal drum, raised lead seams, small foreground dome caps and gold spindle/crescent finials; pale horizontal cornice.

pictures.author: Serhinho
pictures.observed: Three pointed front arches on four pale shafts, dark collars/tie rods, low solid front parapets, central open doorway with shell-shaped head and neutral plaque area, rectangular gridded lower windows/pointed upper windows. Central decorated drinking fountain projects in front of the basement. Exact inscriptions/floral carving excluded.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Library of Ahmed III/Enderun Library: mapped cross-shaped marble building, raised basement and paired side stairs, open three-bay pointed-arch portico/four pale shafts, real central doorway, two recessed window rows with metal grilles, main lead dome on octagonal drum, three small portico domes, low barrel roofs over three arms and front fountain. No copied inscriptions, floral carving, visitors, planting or furnished library.
